# Lemmy

A [Gemma 4 26B A4B](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it) finetune by [lthn.ai](https://lthn.ai) — EUPL-1.2

## Use

**MLX**: [4bit](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemmy/tree/4bit), [5bit](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemmy/tree/5bit), [6bit](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemmy/tree/6bit), [8bit](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemmy/tree/8bit), [bf16](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemmy/tree/bf16), [mxfp4](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemmy/tree/mxfp4), [mxfp8](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemmy/tree/mxfp8), [nvfp4](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemmy/tree/nvfp4)

[Lemer (E2B)](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemer) · [Lemma (E4B)](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemma) · [Lemmy (26B)](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemmy) · [Lemrd (31B)](https://huggingface.co/lthn/lemrd)
